$comment: The docker run arguments of the imp-host container, one array per line of the unit, without the image. bun run render:deploy writes them into deploy/imp-host.service and bootstrap.sh's copy; deploy/nixos/module.nix reads this file. A word $NAME (unbraced) is zero or more words from the env file in the unit, and a module option in Nix. --hostname: restic's backup locks name the host (docs/architecture/backups.md).
